member.name: T:WhisperDesk.Addons.IWhisperDeskAddon
member.summary: Implement this in a .NET 8 class library. Put the DLL and an addon.json manifest (id, name, author, entry, capabilities) in a folder under %LOCALAPPDATA%\WhisperDesk\addons\ (Tools → Add-ons → Open add-ons folder). WhisperDesk shows the capabilities to the user and, once approved, runs the add-on in a separate sandboxed process (a Windows AppContainer) that only receives the events and access it was granted. See sdk\README.md.
